name: Shandong Bailong Chuangyuan Bio-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Bailong Chuangyuan Bio-Tech Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of food and feed additives in China and internationally. The company offers dietary fibers, including polydextrose and resistant dextrin; prebiotics, such as fructo-oligosaccharide, isomalto-oligosaccharide, galacto-oligosaccharide, and xylo-oligosaccharide. It also provides starch sugars comprising allulose, maltitol, organic maltodextrin, allulose psicose, isomalt, and isomaltulose, as well as allulose powder and maltitol syrups. The company sells its products to manufacturers, traders, and retail customers of food, beverages, dairy products, health products, pharmaceuticals, animal nutrition, and feed sector…
